findings.description: The findings; empty when the review found nothing.

file.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to the working directory.

line.description: 1-based line; 0 for the file as a whole.

summary.description: What is wrong, in a sentence or two.

failure_scenario.description: The concrete input or sequence of events that makes it go wrong, and what the user then sees.

category.description: security, data-loss, crash, correctness, concurrency, performance, reliability, error-handling, compatibility, maintainability, style, docs or tests.

outcome.description: Where it stands; open by default.

short_summary.description: A label of a few words for the collapsed row.
